subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with using the tools in the tilemap editor to update the tilemap?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Where might each tile asset be placed so that multiple buildings are created in different sizes and styles?


❓ How might each structure look similar and different?


❓ Where might each structure be placed on the tilemap to distinguish between them?


Solution:

The tilemap should contain 2+ buildings that use different tiles to create structures of different sizes and styles, like the example below:
steps.instructions:
Use the tile editor to rearrange original pixel art tile assets in the project!


When the project is run, there are several tiles already on the tilemap, but they’re all out of order!


Rearrange the tiles on the myTilemap asset so that when the project is run, at least 2 buildings of different sizes and styles appear on screen.


Use the tools in the tilemap editor to modify where each tile asset is placed!

subgroups.title: Debugging Building with Multiple Custom Tiles
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.failureText: Try rereading the instructions, then updating the placement of the tile assets.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 8 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original tile assets to build unique tilemaps. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 8:

badges.title: Mapping It Out
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original tile assets that can be used for top-down or 2D tilemaps.

badges.title: A Whole New World
badges.description: Create original tile assets, including ground terrain and floating platform tiles, that can be used to design a 2D tilemap.

badges.title: Open Concept
badges.description: Create original tile assets that can be combined in a variety of ways to design structures that span multiple tiles.

badges.title: Changing It Up
badges.description: Change a sprite’s movement ability based on its location in relation to a specific tile kind.
